mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(view_count, 0) FROM articles WHERE id = #{articleId}
SELECT count(1) FROM article_favorites WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
SELECT count(1) FROM comments WHERE article_id = #{articleId}

SELECT A.slug, A.title, A.description, count(AF.user_id) AS favoriteCount FROM articles A INNER JOIN article_favorites AF ON A.id = AF.article_id WHERE AF.created_at >= datetime('now', '-' || #{days} || ' days') GROUP BY A.id ORDER BY favoriteCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
